editorial.blurb: Wolf & Company is a warm, multi-level gem where thoughtful cooking—from perfectly charred double burgers to poached salmon with crispy skin—meets an impressive bar program and a grocer's curated touch.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or make a reservation, then look for the 'restaurant upstairs' sign; the upstairs dining room overlooks the bar and is worth the climb. If you come by bike via the 606 trail, there's dedicated bike parking on the patio level.
